summary: Courses Production readability R4. One dense full-width learning row per course replaces the desktop two-column split: real cover left, title and factual metadata in the main rail, grouped learning actions in a right rail. Course title, intro, metadata, stats and action typography are increased for readability while compact spacing and mobile 44px targets remain. Continue Learning and course-state semantics are unchanged. Navigation and Shared Shell, canonical books storage, frozen Channels/Watch/Topics, schema/data/auth/security/provider/updater mechanisms are unchanged. OWNER_DIRECT_RELEASE applies under the current bounded UI closure authorization. Production remains Owner manual.
